# Apple's 2026 and 2027 Mac Roadmap: Every Model and When It Ships

by Juli Clover

A shortage of memory chips has impacted the entire computer market, affecting Macs and PCs alike. Apple and other companies have raised prices, but Apple is better positioned than its competitors. Machines like the Mac mini and the Mac Studio are in demand for on-device AI agent use, and Apple plans to take advantage by refreshing its Mac lineup across 2026 and 2027.

Apples 2026 andd 2027 Roadmap Feature  
Apple already launched the MacBook Neo and refreshed the MacBook Air and MacBook Pro models with M5-series chips, but there are more updates coming before the end of the year. [...] MacBook Pro

Pre-order Now, Launches Nov 6

Spec bump to the M6 chip for the low-end 14-inch model, plus new high-end PROLED XDR models with touchscreen displays.

ipad mini oled square sidebar

iPad mini

Pre-order Now, Launches Nov 6

8.5-inch OLED display, A20 Pro chip, IP67 water and dust resistance, and a thinner and lighter design.

imac 3 blue

M6 iMac

Pre-order Now, Launches Nov 6

Spec bump to the M6 chip.

homeview square sidebar

Apple HomeView

Pre-Order Now, Launches Nov 13

Apple's smart home hub with 7-inch square display, A18 chip with Siri AI support, and more.

• iPhone 18

See full product calendar

## Other Stories

iphone duo facetime

iPhone Duo: Let Someone Join FaceTime on the Outer Display

10 hours ago by Tim Hardwick

reachability iphone duo [...] ## Chip Mixing

According to Bloomberg, Apple is moving up development of its M7 chips that are built for AI workloads, skipping some M6 chips. Apple won't come out with an M6 Pro or M6 Max chip, which is why the first ‌OLED‌ ‌MacBook Pro‌ models will use M5 Pro and M5 Max chips instead of newer technology. Apple's rough chip release schedule:

 M5 Ultra - Late 2026
 M6 - Late 2026
 M7 - First half of 2027
 M7 Pro - End of 2027
 M7 Max - End of 2027
 M7 Ultra - 2028

## Memory Prices

Global memory shortages caused Apple to make major changes to its Mac and iPad pricing in June, and prior to that, Apple discontinued some ‌Mac mini‌ and ‌Mac Studio‌ models that included higher RAM upgrade options. Limited memory availability could affect Apple's Mac launch plans, so timing could shift.

Article: Giant iPhone Duo Installs: 150+ Units Reported [2026]
Source: shattered.io
Published: 2026-10-22T14:00:50+00:00
URL: https://shattered.io/giant-iphone-duo-installations-apple-fifth-avenue-2026
Content: Market Impact: Foldables, Retail, and Rivals A foldable from Apple changes the pricing conversation for the whole category. Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold line and other Android foldables have worked for years to convince mainstream buyers that a folding phone is worth the money. Apple entering with a $1,999 starting price tells shoppers the category now belongs at the premium end. Retail is the second lever. Apple uses its stores as a distribution channel and as a marketing channel at once. Spending more than 150 demo units on one location is a bet that foot traffic converts, and it gives a rough sense of how seriously Apple takes the launch. [...] Apple uncovered the structures for launch day. Covered displays rarely stay covered past the event they support, and the giant iPhone Duo installations were revealed around the October 23 launch. Fifth Avenue will draw the longest demo lines in the country. The reported 150-plus allocation is built for crowds, and flagship traffic will fill it. Demo units are likely to stay scarce at ordinary stores. With reportedly around 20 units each, staff may limit hands-on time. Delivery estimates will keep the shortage story alive. Supply reports and our earlier coverage both point to constrained stock for weeks. Rivals will lean on price in their marketing. A $1,999 starting point gives Android foldable makers an easy comparison to attack. [...] iPhone Duo Price: The $1,999 Starting Point The reported U.S. starting price is $1,999. That sits at the top of the phone market, and it frames everything else about the launch. At that price, a store cannot sell the iPhone Duo as an impulse upgrade. It has to sell it as a considered purchase, which is why the demo investment looks rational. Our own reporting tracked the demand side. We covered how the iPhone Duo sold out in 3 minutes with ship dates slipping into 2027. Strong demand and a four-figure price are not a contradiction here. Early adopters of foldables tend to be less price sensitive, and scarcity feeds the appetite.

Source: shattered.io
Published: 2026-10-22T14:00:50+00:00
URL: https://shattered.io/giant-iphone-duo-installations-apple-fifth-avenue-2026
Content: Market Impact: Foldables, Retail, and Rivals A foldable from Apple changes the pricing conversation for the whole category. Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold line and other Android foldables have worked for years to convince mainstream buyers that a folding phone is worth the money. Apple entering with a $1,999 starting price tells shoppers the category now belongs at the premium end. Retail is the second lever. Apple uses its stores as a distribution channel and as a marketing channel at once. Spending more than 150 demo units on one location is a bet that foot traffic converts, and it gives a rough sense of how seriously Apple takes the launch. [...] Apple uncovered the structures for launch day. Covered displays rarely stay covered past the event they support, and the giant iPhone Duo installations were revealed around the October 23 launch. Fifth Avenue will draw the longest demo lines in the country. The reported 150-plus allocation is built for crowds, and flagship traffic will fill it. Demo units are likely to stay scarce at ordinary stores. With reportedly around 20 units each, staff may limit hands-on time. Delivery estimates will keep the shortage story alive. Supply reports and our earlier coverage both point to constrained stock for weeks. Rivals will lean on price in their marketing. A $1,999 starting point gives Android foldable makers an easy comparison to attack. [...] iPhone Duo Price: The $1,999 Starting Point The reported U.S. starting price is $1,999. That sits at the top of the phone market, and it frames everything else about the launch. At that price, a store cannot sell the iPhone Duo as an impulse upgrade. It has to sell it as a considered purchase, which is why the demo investment looks rational. Our own reporting tracked the demand side. We covered how the iPhone Duo sold out in 3 minutes with ship dates slipping into 2027. Strong demand and a four-figure price are not a contradiction here. Early adopters of foldables tend to be less price sensitive, and scarcity feeds the appetite.

# Apple's 2026 and 2027 Mac Roadmap: Every Model and When It Ships

by Juli Clover

A shortage of memory chips has impacted the entire computer market, affecting Macs and PCs alike. Apple and other companies have raised prices, but Apple is better positioned than its competitors. Machines like the Mac mini and the Mac Studio are in demand for on-device AI agent use, and Apple plans to take advantage by refreshing its Mac lineup across 2026 and 2027.

Apples 2026 andd 2027 Roadmap Feature  
Apple already launched the MacBook Neo and refreshed the MacBook Air and MacBook Pro models with M5-series chips, but there are more updates coming before the end of the year. [...] MacBook Pro

## Other Stories

iphone duo facetime

iPhone Duo: Let Someone Join FaceTime on the Outer Display

10 hours ago by Tim Hardwick

reachability iphone duo [...] ## Chip Mixing

According to Bloomberg, Apple is moving up development of its M7 chips that are built for AI workloads, skipping some M6 chips. Apple won't come out with an M6 Pro or M6 Max chip, which is why the first ‌OLED‌ ‌MacBook Pro‌ models will use M5 Pro and M5 Max chips instead of newer technology. Apple's rough chip release schedule:

 M5 Ultra - Late 2026
 M6 - Late 2026
 M7 - First half of 2027
 M7 Pro - End of 2027
 M7 Max - End of 2027
 M7 Ultra - 2028

## Memory Prices

Global memory shortages caused Apple to make major changes to its Mac and iPad pricing in June, and prior to that, Apple discontinued some ‌Mac mini‌ and ‌Mac Studio‌ models that included higher RAM upgrade options. Limited memory availability could affect Apple's Mac launch plans, so timing could shift.

# Apple's 2026 and 2027 Mac Roadmap: Every Model and When It Ships

by Juli Clover

A shortage of memory chips has impacted the entire computer market, affecting Macs and PCs alike. Apple and other companies have raised prices, but Apple is better positioned than its competitors. Machines like the Mac mini and the Mac Studio are in demand for on-device AI agent use, and Apple plans to take advantage by refreshing its Mac lineup across 2026 and 2027.

reachability iphone duo [...] ## Chip Mixing

According to Bloomberg, Apple is moving up development of its M7 chips that are built for AI workloads, skipping some M6 chips. Apple won't come out with an M6 Pro or M6 Max chip, which is why the first ‌OLED‌ ‌MacBook Pro‌ models will use M5 Pro and M5 Max chips instead of newer technology. Apple's rough chip release schedule:

 M5 Ultra - Late 2026
 M6 - Late 2026
 M7 - First half of 2027
 M7 Pro - End of 2027
 M7 Max - End of 2027
 M7 Ultra - 2028

## Memory Prices

Global memory shortages caused Apple to make major changes to its Mac and iPad pricing in June, and prior to that, Apple discontinued some ‌Mac mini‌ and ‌Mac Studio‌ models that included higher RAM upgrade options. Limited memory availability could affect Apple's Mac launch plans, so timing could shift.

Content: The $100 price gap favors Samsung on paper. Whether it matters depends on supply. A buyer who cannot get a Duo before late January will not weigh $100 for long. Historical Context: Apple Arrives Late and Prices High Apple rarely launches a category first. It tends to enter after competitors have shaken out the early problems, then prices at the top of the market and bets that integration justifies the premium. The iPhone Duo follows that script. Samsung and other makers have sold foldables for years, which is why Ternus could criticize existing designs so directly. [...] That pattern is common when a dominant brand validates a niche. Shoppers who had never considered a foldable start browsing, and many end up buying the product that is in stock. With the Duo constrained, rivals pick up the overflow. | Factor | Apple iPhone Duo | Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 | --- | Starting price (U.S.) | $1,999 | $1,899 (per our earlier report) | | Opened display | 7.6 inches | Not compared here | | Availability | In stores since Oct. 23, shipping late Jan. 2027 | On sale | | Marketing stance | Ternus: rivals feel like two phones stuck together | Billboards pointing at the $1,999 Duo | | Colors at launch | Star white, night sky | Not compared here | [...] This analysis sorts confirmed facts from unconfirmed claims, walks through the payment math, and explains why a famous product name plus a “leaked price” is an ideal lure for scammers. It also covers how the competition is responding. Our earlier report on the iPhone Duo shortage and late January 2027 shipping covers the supply side, so this piece focuses on pricing and trust. · Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google Add Tech Insider once in the Google app and our stories appear in your news suggestions.
